answer: Bound weight by vertex-disjoint vouching paths to the honest core, not headcount. Count the maximum paths to the core sharing no intermediate vertex; cap weight there. A sybil cluster, however many keys it mints, reaches the core through a few choke vertices, collapsing to that thin cut. Each counted path carries a staked bond slashed if the vouchee is convicted, so widening the cut costs real capital and independent vouchers no attacker can fabricate. A ripple of fresh aliases adds internal edges that raise no path count. Weight tracks the ridge of independent trust inflow, not keys.
